releases.notes:
# Update 0.2.0-B is here!
This is a major feature update to add new gameplay and features to the mod!
Feedback I got often was that some cards were a bit too costly for their effects, so a lot of cards have been reduced in BP!

### Additions
- 4 New Cards
- 1 New Potion Effect (Only obtainable via a card)
- Decking Enchantment added (can be applied to all armour, gives +1BP per level, max level 3)
- Recipe to Duplicate Cards (8 Card Shreds + any card == 2 of inputted card)
- PowerCards now has a Config file (can currently be used to set starting BP, max BP, and combat time)

### Changes
- Card Items now stack up to 4
- Card loot is now drastically more common in loot chests (excluding village chests, shipwreck map chests, and spawn chests)
- Starting BP by default is now 5 (from 3)

### Card Balance
- Fortify BP reduced from 8 >>> 7
- Healthy Heart BP reduced from 3 >>> 2
- Feelin' Fine BP reduced from 2 >>> 1
- Holding BP reduced from 6 >>> 4
- Eyes Open BP reduced from 2 >>> 1
- Spring Jump initial charge time reduced from 1.5s >>> 1s

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed Card Shreds recipe not working
- Fixed Additional BP effects not working

### Update 0.1.1-B is here!
This is a minor update that adds a new translation, a new trader, and some code-cleanup.

### Additions
- The mod has been translated into Spanish (Spain) ~ Everyone say thank you to PraetorNG!
- 50% of Wandering Traders will now instead be selling only cards instead of their usual stuff.

### Removals
- Wandering Traders no longer have a random chance of selling cards among their main stock.

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed Wandering Trader card offer tables being generated on boot instead of for each trader spawning.

releases.notes:
### PowerCards is here!
Inspired by games such as Paper Mario and Block Tales, PowerCards adds a bunch of cards and a deckbuilding system, allowing players to make unique builds and play their way! Each card has a cost, abilities, and effects, and players can find card packs and shreds throughout their world to obtain the build of their dreams, no matter how silly!

As the first Public Beta Release, I implore you to break my mod and tell me how you did it!

To great things, then? -Desh
